endpoints.request_shape: {raw_situation_text: string, input_method: string, input_language: string, preferred_language?: string}
endpoints.description: Creates or updates this session's anonymous profile from one typed or transcribed sentence: it redacts ID-like numbers, sends the sentence to OpenAI only to extract class level, institution type, state and income band with confidence flags, drops low-confidence and out-of-set values, sets out_of_scope when class is not 11 or 12, and runs the deterministic rules engine to recalculate results; used by the 'Tell Us About Your Situation' screen.
Returns this session's profile with its unanswered fields so the follow-up flow asks only the highest-value missing question; used by the follow-up flow, results and deadline screens.

Loads the chosen fictional demo persona into this session as a profile with is_demo true, replacing the session's current profile, so judges can run the demo without typing; used by the Demo Mode switch.
Lists the preloaded fictional demo personas with a label and a one-line summary, without any real data, for the Demo Mode switch.

Sends one microphone recording to OpenAI speech-to-text in English or the regional language and returns the transcript for the person to confirm on the 'Tell Us About Your Situation' screen; the audio is not stored.
Lists the curated active schemes for the configured state with name, short description, official source, last_verified_at and deadline, for the deadline tracker and catalogue views.
Returns one scheme's full detail with plain-language explanation, estimated benefit, common rejection risks, official_url and 'Last verified on' date, used by the Scheme Detail screen.

Returns the editable eligibility rules for one scheme with each rule's plain-language text, reason and verification question, so the Scheme Detail screen can show why it matched and what still needs verification.
Lists the documents a scheme asks for, in sort order, so the Scheme Detail and Document Checklist screens can show them before anything is saved.
Lists the numbered official application steps for a scheme in step_number order, so the Scheme Detail and Document Checklist screens can show how to apply.

Returns this session's result for every scheme, with status, previous_status and changed_rule_id, so the Results screen can group them as Likely eligible, May qualify and Not currently eligible; the optional status filter returns one group only.

Returns one result with matched_rule_ids, failed_rule_ids, unverified_rule_ids, unverified_requirements and the plain-language reason_text and why_not_fit, so the Scheme Detail screen can show why it matched and what still needs verification.
Lists the checklists this session has saved, one per scheme, for the Document Checklist and Application Steps screen.

Saves a personalised checklist for one scheme from the Scheme Detail screen: it copies that scheme's required documents and application steps into checklist_items as not done, sets progress_status to not_started and eligibility_category from the current result, and rejects a second save of the same scheme.
Returns one saved checklist with its document and step items, for the tick-off list and progress buttons on the Document Checklist and Application Steps screen.
Removes a saved checklist and its items when the student stops tracking that scheme from the checklist screen.
Moves progress_status from not_started to documents_ready and stamps status_updated_at, rejecting the call from any other status; used by the Deadline and Progress Tracker screen.
Moves progress_status from documents_ready to applied and stamps status_updated_at, rejecting the call from any other status; used by the Deadline and Progress Tracker screen.
Moves progress_status from applied to awaiting_outcome and stamps status_updated_at, rejecting the call from any other status; used by the Deadline and Progress Tracker screen.
Ticks or unticks one document or step and sets completed_at when it is ticked, for the tick-off boxes on the Document Checklist screen.
Builds a plain-text summary of the scheme name, official link, deadline, documents and steps, with no income, class, school or identity details, for the Share this checklist with family button.

endpoints.response_shape: {checklist_id: string, scheme_id: string, scheme_name: string, deadline: string, days_until_deadline: number, progress_status: string}[]
endpoints.description: Returns each saved checklist with its scheme deadline, days_until_deadline (calendar days from today to the deadline, negative once it has passed) and progress_status, for the countdowns and tracker on the Deadline and Progress Tracker screen.
Lists the questions this session has answered or skipped in capture_order, so the Follow-up Question Flow does not ask them again.

endpoints.response_shape: {question_key: string, question_text: string, optional: boolean, answered_or_skipped: number} | null
endpoints.description: Returns the highest-value question not yet answered or skipped, with optional and answered_or_skipped (count of questions already answered or skipped), or null once two to four questions are answered or skipped, for the Follow-up Question Flow screen.

endpoints.request_shape: header X-Session-Token: string; {question_key: string, answer: string}
endpoints.description: Saves an answer to the question shown next, checks it against the allowed values for its question_key, sets captured_order, re-evaluates every scheme against the rules, and returns the results whose status changed; it rejects a question_key that is already answered or skipped.

Records an optional question as skipped, adds it to the profile's skipped_questions, re-evaluates results so schemes that depend on it show as May qualify, and returns the changed results; it rejects questions the rules do not mark optional.

Changes a previously given answer, re-evaluates every scheme, and returns the results whose status changed with previous_status and changed_rule_id, powering the What changes my result? interaction on the Results screen.
Returns the parent's own record linking this session to the child's profile, for the parent's details on the Results screen.

endpoints.request_shape: header X-Session-Token: string; {relationship: mother|father|guardian|other, town?: string}
endpoints.description: Creates the parent's record from the Tell Us About Your Situation screen, sets child_profile_id from this session's profile, and rejects a second record for the same parent.
Updates the parent's relationship or town on the parent record.
Removes the parent's record so the parent can start again from the Tell Us About Your Situation screen.
Removes this session's demo profile and its results, checklists and answers, so the session returns to an empty state.

Takes a result reason, rule text or step instruction and the preferred_language, and returns it in simple language or the regional language, so Results, Scheme Detail and read-aloud can show it in the

Saves preferred_language, display_name, transcript_confirmed and intake answers (class level, institution type, state, income), then re-evaluates every scheme and returns the results whose status chan
Clears this session's profile, follow-up answers, eligibility results, checklists and parent record so the person can start a new check.

Returns this session's result for one scheme, with status, matched, failed and unverified rules, reason_text, why_not_fit and unverified_requirements, so the Scheme Detail screen can show why it match
Takes Welcome and Privacy page text, follow-up questions and their options, 'What we understood' items, tracker text and read-aloud text, with preferred_language, and returns it in simple language or
